name: The Forest of Tangled Threads
source:
After their party’s healer is cursed with a mysterious illness, Malen and Valina— a paladin and magician duo— must venture into a demonic forest in order to save her. Tensions rise as Malen ruminates over her own past, as well as her and Valina’s relationship; why is it different ever since Lorel joined their party? Can it be mended again now that she’s out of the picture? Or will The Heart’s trials destroy them both?

[From [url=https://gaybreast.itch.io/forest]itch.io[/url]]
